content:
AIChatApp Config Reference

- The API local model settings live under LocalModel in AIChatApp.API/appsettings.json and AIChatApp.API/appsettings.Development.json.
- LocalModel:FileName selects which GGUF file to load from AIChatApp.Core/Models.
- LocalModel:ContextSize controls the local model context window passed to the runtime.
- AssistantProfile:ProfileId selects which assistant prompt and knowledge folder is active.
- AssistantProfile:AssistantName controls the assistant label used in prompts and chat responses.
- Frontend:GatewayBaseUrl in AIChatApp.Web config tells the Blazor app which gateway base URL to call.
- In local development, Frontend:GatewayBaseUrl should be https://localhost:7067/ so authenticated chat calls do not lose Authorization headers during HTTP-to-HTTPS redirects.
- Frontend:ApiClientName and Frontend:ApiKey in AIChatApp.Web config supply the gateway headers used by the frontend.
- JwtSettings controls JWT issuer, audience, and signing key for local authentication.
- ApiKey.Settings controls the gateway client name and accepted API keys.
- ConnectionStrings controls the application database connections.
- Use user secrets for local sensitive values and environment variables for Docker or deployed environments.
Web route reference:
- AIChatApp.Web hosts /chat, /backoffice, and /faqs.
- ML Training navigation now lives inside Backoffice under Machine Learning.
- AIChatApp.Web.csproj excludes generated artifacts folders so temporary build outputs are not copied recursively into bin.
